clues: This city sits on the coast in the south west of Cyprus. It is the capital town of its own district.
Of all towns on this island, this one has the mildest temperatures. Its warm climate is the softest here.
Long ago, this place was one of the city kingdoms of Cyprus. Each such kingdom ruled its own small state in the old days.
Strange but true: two spots once shared this name, an old one and a new one. At times, each one was the capital of the old state.
Its old ruins hold a rare world prize, won in 1980 for proof of a lost way of life. UNESCO placed them on its World Heritage list.
